The '''Time of Panic''' was the name given to the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sixty Hour War|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]] in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. During those months, the residents of the Elrood sector prepared for the worst believing that the Empire, having secured Derilyn, would sweep through the rest of the sector.
